definitions.explanation: One's best performance or score ever achieved.

examples.japanese: ⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{自己|じこ}ベスト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}した→更新：04765_koushin⟧。
examples.english: I set a new personal best in the marathon.

examples.japanese: {自己|じこ}ベスト⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あと→後：09580_ato⟧⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦{届|とど}かなかった→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: I was just short of my personal best.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自己|じこ}ベスト⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧！
examples.english: Today's record is my personal best!

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧ (self) + ⟦ベスト→ベスト：04681_besuto⟧ (best, from English) — a Japanese-made compound rather than a borrowing of the English phrase.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自己|じこ}ベスト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to achieve a personal best
- {自己|じこ}ベスト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to break one's personal record (the most common phrase by far)
- {自己|じこ}ベスト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aim for a personal best
- {自己|じこ}ベスト⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to match one's personal best

SHORTER FORMS:
Among athletes the word is often clipped to {自己|じこ}ベ, or written PB after the English. Both are casual and belong to spoken club talk rather than broadcast commentary.

WHERE IT IS USED:
This is the standard word in any sport measured by time, distance, or score — track and field, swimming, marathons, weightlifting. It is neutral in register; the informality lies only in the clipped forms above.
